name: Pipeliners - Site-Wide SEO Fix Plan Four Faults 2026-08-19
body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-08-19

# Summary
A Word doc (19 Aug 2026) of remediation steps for four faults that repeat on the three priority URLs: /buckeye/, the homepage and /paradise-valley/. Data: GSC (US) May 19 to Aug 17 vs Feb 18 to May 18. Proposals only. Constraint noted throughout: Rank Math is deactivated, so titles, H1s, metas and schema are set in OTTO; Elementor caches must be cleared and the CDN purged for changes to show.

# The four faults
1. **Rebuild the H2 layer:** query-matching headings sat at H3/H4 while H2s held filler ("Understanding Trenchless Technology" was byte-identical on two pages). Rule: one H2 per query family with a service noun and the city; never reuse an H2 across city pages. Keep "Pipe Repair in Buckeye" (position 6) intact. Homepage retreats to brand and statewide so /phoenix/ can consolidate, in two phases.
2. **One FAQPage per URL:** Buckeye and Paradise Valley emitted two FAQPage blocks (36 questions). Keep the mu-plugin as the single emitter, cut to about 8 questions matched to GSC queries, enforce visible parity. Notes that FAQ rich results were retired for most sites in Aug 2023.
3. **Add LocalBusiness schema:** none existed. A sitewide Plumber/LocalBusiness entity with confirm-first values (phone, review count, exact geo, real hours).
4. **Citations and links:** claim Tier 1 citations after fixing NAP, then manufacturer and trade directories (Perma-Liner, ePIPE/ACE DuraFlo installer list, NASSCO, chambers, ROC lookup). Do not disavow the spam profile; do not repeat press-release syndication.

Also flagged: rendering defects (empty white bands, black video blocks), likely LiteSpeed JS Minify.

# Superseded points
The tables propose "Emergency & Same-Day" H2s, price sections and 24/7 hours. Since Oct 1 these are banned (no 24/7, no same day, no prices).
